# Kiwi Pop llms.txt

> Kiwi Pop makes lollipop-shaped party supplements: functional candy for the night scene.

## What is Kiwi Pop?

Kiwi Pop is a functional lollipop. Every flavor shares the same functional base: jambu (Acmella oleracea, the Brazilian buzz-button flower that produces an electric mouth tingle on the first lick), theobromine, B12 methylcobalamin, magnesium glycinate, taurine, electrolytes, and edible mica glitter, plus a flavor-specific adaptogen tuned to each flavor's sensory direction. Each pop has less than 1 gram of sugar, approximately 35 calories, and is 100% vegan. Sweetened with monk fruit and xylitol on an isomalt base. Manufactured in small batches in Salt Lake City, Utah.

## Products

- Kiwi Pop (kiwi flavor): $5 single / $25 6-pack / $60 20-pack (party pack). Adaptogen: ginseng + spirulina (balanced, all-purpose).
- Luci Ginger Lemon (lemon + ginger): preorder. Adaptogen: ashwagandha (calm-warming; pairs with ginger).
- Molly Matcha Mint (matcha + peppermint + spearmint): preorder. Adaptogen: L-theanine + chamomile (calm-focus; triple-cooling alongside mint + jambu + xylitol).
- Mary Caramel Apple Cinn (caramel apple + cinnamon): preorder. Adaptogen: maca + cinnamon (grounded energy; reinforces caramel + blood-sugar support).
- Variety Packs: 8 ($30, 2 of each), 20 ($60, 5 of each), 40 ($100, 10 of each)

## Key facts

- Less than 1 g sugar per pop
- ~35 calories per pop
- Vegan, gluten-free
- Contains jambu (Acmella oleracea) extract, the spilanthol-based mouth tingle, used in food-flavor amount, not a supplement dose; not psychoactive; does not interact with alcohol
- Edible mica glitter inside
- Free shipping on orders over $40
- Ships from Salt Lake City, Utah (US-domestic first)

## Disclaimers

These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Not for use by persons under 18. Consult a healthcare professional before use. Sugar alcohols (isomalt, xylitol) may cause GI upset in large quantities. Xylitol is toxic to dogs.
